about: Test-point guidance library — MEER Tool Pro (Round 2, Group 6). September-patch ke baad naye models par BROM ki software entry (crash preloader / force BROM) aksar band hai; wahan entry physical test point se hoti hai (SEPT-SEC-RESEARCH section 2, Layer 1; SERVER-REQUIRED-ROUTES-RESEARCH-2 §8.16).

MODEL_CODE.brand: Infinix / Tecno / Itel / Samsung / Xiaomi / OnePlus
MODEL_CODE.confidence: 'verified' (bench photo ya bharosa-mand public source se tasdeeq) ya 'unverified' (location abhi verify nahi — guess nahi, sirf model/chip verified)
MODEL_CODE.image: tools/testpoints/ me tasveer ka path ya null
MODEL_CODE.location: TP ki jagah — apne alfaaz me (masalan: battery connector ke left, sunehra nuqta, 'TP' print). UNVERIFIED entry me yahan sirf imaandar 'abhi nahi' likha hota hai, andaze wali jagah NAHI.
MODEL_CODE.note: Purana field — location jaisa hi (backward compat ke liye).
MODEL_CODE.procedure: Step-by-step: kya kholna hai, kya short karna hai, cable kab lagani hai.
MODEL_CODE.source: Jahan se mila (forum thread / apna bench tajurba + tareekh). UNVERIFIED entry me source sirf model/chip ki tasdeeq batata hai, point ki nahi.

honesty_note: Kisi model ki test-point LOCATION is file me sirf TAB jama hogi jab wo kisi public/bharosa-mand source se mili ho ya Hamza ne apne board par khud verify ki ho. Andaze wali location likhna phone/board kharab kar sakta hai — is liye seed entries 'unverified' hain: un ka model + chip verified hai (GSMArena, research R2 §2), lekin POINT LOCATION abhi verify nahi. Chimera / UnlockTool ki DB wholesale scrape/copy NAHI ki gayi — ye apni DB hai, naye models pehle.

CN5c.location: Tasdeeq-shuda test-point location abhi is library me NAHI hai — board par 'TP' print / sunehra nuqta dhoondo; bench photo se verify karke hi chhuo. Andaze se koi point short mat karo.
CN5c.note: Tasdeeq-shuda test-point location abhi is library me NAHI hai — board par 'TP' print / sunehra nuqta dhoondo; bench photo se verify karke hi chhuo.
CN5c.procedure: Phone band karo, pichhla cover / shield ehtiyat se kholo, board par model ke test point ko tweezers se GND se short karte hue USB cable lagao — Device Manager me MediaTek Preloader/BROM port ana chahiye. Point milte hi short chhor do.
CN5c.source: Model + chip verified: DB + GSMArena (Camon 50 Pro, Mar 2026) — research R2 §2.3. TP location: UNVERIFIED — koi public tasveer/forum post verify nahi hui (web search 2026-10-25).

Seed entries ke model + chip GSMArena / research R2 §2 se verified hain; kisi bhi entry ki POINT LOCATION verified nahi — is liye sab 'unverified' hain. Chimera/UnlockTool ki DB se kuch copy nahi kiya gaya.
